int_name: E CLARKSON AVE & RISING SUN AVE

result.summary: The image shows a commercial urban intersection with a marked continental crosswalk and a sidewalk. While basic infrastructure like curb ramps and traffic signals are present, the environment lacks pedestrian-specific signals and physical buffers from the multi-lane roadway.

hazards.name: Missing Pedestrian Signals
hazards.description: No dedicated pedestrian signal heads are visible, forcing pedestrians to rely on vehicular signals which may not provide adequate clearance time.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Buffer
hazards.description: The sidewalk is directly adjacent to the travel lanes with no trees or bollards to protect pedestrians from traffic.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install dedicated pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to improve crossing safety and predictability.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Greenery
interventions.description: Plant street trees to provide a physical and psychological buffer between pedestrians and traffic.

result.summary: The image shows a signalized residential intersection with a high-visibility zebra crosswalk and sidewalks on both sides. While basic infrastructure like curb ramps and traffic signals are present, the wide roadway and parked vehicles near the crossing create potential visibility and exposure risks for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction from Parked Cars
hazards.description: Vehicles parked close to the crosswalk on the right side of the image may obstruct the sightlines between drivers and pedestrians entering the crosswalk.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the intersection along the curb.

hazards.name: Unprotected Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross multiple lanes of traffic without a median or refuge island, increasing exposure time.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Install curb extensions at the corners to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces immediately adjacent to the crosswalk to ensure clear sightlines.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval (LPI)
interventions.description: Program the traffic signal to give pedestrians a head start before vehicles get a green light, reducing conflicts with turning traffic.

result.summary: A signalized residential intersection featuring high-visibility continental crosswalks and pedestrian signals. The environment includes sidewalks on both sides and a marked bike lane, though the crossing distance across the multi-lane roadway is relatively long without a median refuge.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The width of the roadway requires pedestrians to be exposed to traffic for a significant duration without a mid-point refuge.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the main roadway at the marked crosswalk.

hazards.name: Sight Line Obstruction
hazards.description: Dense vegetation on the corner may limit visibility between drivers and pedestrians waiting to cross.
hazards.location_in_image: Left foreground corner near the red wall.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs to shorten the crossing distance and improve the visibility of pedestrians to approaching drivers.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Add a raised island in the center of the roadway to allow pedestrians to cross in two stages.

result.summary: The intersection features paved sidewalks and a vehicle traffic signal but lacks basic pedestrian crossing infrastructure. There are no marked crosswalks or pedestrian-specific signals, forcing pedestrians to navigate the roadway without designated protection or timing.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crossing
hazards.description: There are no painted crosswalks at this signalized intersection, reducing driver awareness of pedestrians.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the foreground roadway at the intersection

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Signals
hazards.description: The absence of pedestrian-specific signal heads means walkers must rely on vehicle lights, which may not provide sufficient clearance intervals.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the intersection near the traffic light pole

hazards.name: Sightline Obstruction
hazards.description: Parked vehicles close to the intersection corner can block the view between drivers and pedestrians waiting to cross.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the street, parked cars near the building

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental or ladder-style crosswalk markings to clearly define pedestrian space.
